kultivator.screen.help.kehancuran.title: Mode Kehancuran (OFF by default)
kultivator.screen.help.kehancuran:
Mode Kehancuran is the only way Kultivator changes real blocks. While it is off, every technique, decree and effect is visual only. The rules come in tiers:
1. Server permission: config modeKehancuran (OFF by default) or an operator's /kultivasi kehancuran izin on. Without it no block ever changes.
2a. Your own techniques: one click on the red seal of the Kehancuran page of the Technique Codex, or /kultivasi kehancuran nyala|mati. Carving techniques start at Golden Core; hold Shift while casting to keep that cast block-safe. Details in the "Mode Kehancuran for your own techniques" help.
2b. Disciples: swear the Sumpah Kehancuran, then release one disciple's red seal on its Jalan tab. Only a disciple past calamity 4 has a Jurus Pemusnah, and only its ordered cast changes blocks (automatic casts never do). Every order is aimed, previewed, confirmed in chat, then announced to the whole dimension with a 30-second red-sky countdown you can still cancel.
3. Total Destruction (Hancur Total, ON by default when the server allows it; /kultivasi kehancuran total nyala|mati): your casts, your decrees and your disciples' Destroyer Arts may also destroy bedrock, obsidian, portals, fluids, chests and furnaces. The Sect Hall stele, formation eyes, registered formation lodestones and decree monument blocks are never destroyed. Turned off, the usual rules apply: blocks with contents, portals, bedrock, obsidian and fluids are never touched.
Protected zones for every tier (defaults of config/kultivator.json): 4 blocks around yourself, 24 blocks from beds and respawn points, 24 blocks from any player, 64 blocks from a Sect Hall and its building sites, 32 blocks from villagers, iron golems and protective formations, 6 blocks from disciples, tamed pets and spirit beasts, the world spawn, cave abodes, secret realms, 160 blocks around the End's centre, and unloaded chunks. No drops by default. For 10 minutes a cast can be restored (Red Seal tablet or /kultivasi kehancuran pulihkan); a server restart loses that chance. Closing any lock stops everything at once.
